answer_1.quote: We assess the efficacy of the chat vector across multiple target languages, focusing primarily on Traditional Chinese, by considering three aspects: the ability to follow instructions, toxicity, and multi-turn dialogue.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to prompts in the target language, including instruction-following answers and multi‑turn dialogues.

answer_2.quote: We employ the Perspective API ... to evaluate the toxic nature of our outputs. We also use TMMLU+ to evaluate knowledge retention and GPT‑4 scoring on the Vicuna benchmark.
automatic_metrics: Perspective API scores (TOX, STOX, IA, INS, PRO, THR)

answer_3.quote: We follow the GPT‑4 evaluation method from subsection 4.3 to test the instruction‑following ability of our models ... Then, we use GPT‑4 as a scorer to rate the outputs of other models based on several criteria.
